brief.prompt: Read the function signalRecordedGroup in runtime/fabric/src/run-registry.ts in this repository, or, if it is absent, the function terminateRecordedRun. In at most five bullet points, explain how it decides a recorded process group is safe to signal. Cite line numbers.

Read the function acquire_worktree_lease in skills/orchestrate/scripts/dispatch_run.py in this repository. In at most five bullet points, explain how it keeps a second writer out of a worktree and what a refused writer sees. Cite line numbers.

Combine the two input summaries into one paragraph of at most 120 words describing how Provenant keeps a writer's worktree and its child processes under control. Say which claims the inputs disagree on, if any.
